news.titleEn: US forces strike Iranian rocket launchers on the Strait of Hormuz in first military action in weeks
news.conclusionEn: US forces struck two Iranian Revolutionary Guard rocket launchers on Larak Island on Sunday, saying the units were preparing to fire sea mines into the Strait of Hormuz, and Iranian state TV showed what it said were retaliatory ballistic missiles fired at US bases in Jordan.
news.conclusionZh: 美军周日空袭霍尔木兹海峡拉拉克岛的伊朗火箭发射器，伊朗称已向约旦美军基地还击
news.whyEn: The Strait of Hormuz carries about one-fifth of the world's seaborne oil, so renewed fighting after weeks of calm revives the risk of a supply shock and wider regional escalation.
news.whyZh: 霍尔木兹海峡承载全球约五分之一的海运石油，平静数周后重燃战火，重新点燃供应冲击和地区扩大化风险。
news.detailEn: US Central Command called it a 'limited, precise action' against Guard forces posing an imminent threat to civilian shipping, days after the US cleared mines from the strait's lanes. Iran's Revolutionary Guard acknowledged that several fighters and civilians were killed or wounded and vowed retaliation, and Iranian media reported missile launches at the King Hussein and Muwaffaq Salti air bases in Jordan, where Jordan said it intercepted incoming missiles. The strike is the first US military action in roughly a month, breaking a lull in an intermittent war that began in late February and has severely cut traffic through the waterway. Markets reacted quickly, with crude oil jumping and Asian equities selling off at Monday's open.
news.detailZh: 美军中央司令部称这是针对「对民用航运构成迫在眉睫威胁」的伊朗革命卫队部队的「有限、精确打击」，此前数天美方刚清除了海峡航道上的水雷。革命卫队承认有数名武装人员和平民伤亡并誓言报复，伊朗媒体称已向约旦的侯赛因国王空军基地和穆瓦法克·萨勒提空军基地发射导弹，约旦称拦截了来袭导弹。这是美军约一个月来首次军事行动，打破了始于2月底的间歇性战争的短暂平静，海峡通行量已因此大幅下降。市场迅速反应，原油大涨，亚洲股市周一开盘走低。

news.titleEn: Stock futures fall, Asian markets tumble after US strikes Iranian targets near Strait of Hormuz
news.conclusionEn: US stock futures slipped Sunday night, with Dow futures down about 85 points and S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 futures off roughly 0.2%, while Asian benchmarks dropped sharply, led by South Korea's Kospi down about 3.5% and Japan's Nikkei 225 down about 2.2%.
news.conclusionZh: 美军空袭伊朗后美股期指走低，亚洲股市大跌，韩国综指跌约3.5%、日经跌约2.2%
news.whyEn: The move shows how quickly a geopolitical shock can hit risk assets, and it lands just as investors weigh a possible September Fed rate hike, leaving markets exposed on two fronts.
news.whyZh: 此番下跌显示地缘冲击对风险资产的传导有多快，恰逢投资者权衡美联储9月是否加息，市场两面受压。
news.detailEn: Hong Kong's Hang Seng fell about 0.9% and mainland China's CSI 300 slid about 0.6%, while the US dollar held gains after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole speech. Despite the pullback, Wall Street was still on track for a winning August: the Dow was up around 2.1% for the month heading into the final session, its fifth straight monthly gain, and the S&P 500 and Nasdaq were up roughly 3% and 4%, their first monthly advances since May. The S&P 500 closed Friday at 7,711.76. Traders now turn to Friday's August jobs report and Broadcom earnings as the next tests for the rally.
news.detailZh: 香港恒生指数跌约0.9%，中国沪深300跌约0.6%，美元在美联储主席沃什发表偏鹰的杰克逊霍尔演讲后维持涨势。尽管回调，华尔街8月仍有望收涨：进入最后一个交易日，道指当月涨约2.1%，为连续第五个月上涨，标普和纳指分别涨约3%和4%，是5月以来首次月度上涨。标普500上周五收于7711.76点。交易员接下来关注周五的8月就业报告和博通财报，视其为涨势的下一道考验。

news.titleEn: Oil jumps at week's open as US military hits Iranian launchers
news.conclusionEn: Crude surged as trading resumed, with Brent climbing back above $90 a barrel and West Texas Intermediate near $86, up around 2%, after the US strike on Iranian rocket launchers near the Strait of Hormuz.
news.conclusionZh: 美军空袭后油价开盘跳涨，布伦特重回90美元上方，WTI逼近86美元，涨幅约2%
news.whyEn: Higher oil feeds directly into headline inflation, complicating central banks' decisions, and squeezes transport-heavy businesses and consumers just as US rate-hike bets are rising.
news.whyZh: 油价上涨直接推高整体通胀，令央行决策更棘手，也在美国加息预期升温之际挤压运输密集型企业和消费者。
news.detailEn: The waterway normally handles about a fifth of global seaborne oil, and months of conflict had already cut shipping through it to a fraction of normal levels. Even with the jump, crude is heading for its strongest month since March, supported by the Middle East risk premium, though gains have been capped by softer demand forecasts from OPEC and the IEA and by weak data from China, the world's biggest importer. Traders are watching whether Iran follows through on threats to disrupt tanker traffic further, and whether the US extends its actions. A sustained move higher in energy prices would raise the stakes for the Fed's September meeting.
news.detailZh: 该海峡通常承载全球约五分之一的海运石油，数月冲突已使其通行量降至常态的一小部分。尽管跳涨，受中东风险溢价支撑，原油有望创下3月以来最强月度表现，但涨幅受到OPEC和IEA下调需求预期、以及全球最大进口国中国数据疲软的抑制。交易员正关注伊朗是否兑现进一步扰乱油轮通行的威胁，以及美国是否扩大行动。能源价格若持续走高，将加大美联储9月议息的分量。

news.titleEn: Kevin Warsh sharpens inflation warning at Jackson Hole, signaling a possible rate hike
news.conclusionEn: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh used his Jackson Hole speech to say inflation running at 3.7% remains the central bank's main concern and that underlying trends have not 'meaningfully improved,' pushing market-implied odds of a September rate hike up to roughly 57% from about 40%.
news.conclusionZh: 美联储主席沃什在杰克逊霍尔强化通胀警告，9月加息的市场押注概率从约40%升至约57%
news.whyEn: A rate hike would be the Fed's first in this cycle under Warsh and would lift borrowing costs for mortgages, businesses and governments while putting the chair more openly at odds with President Trump's demand for lower rates.
news.whyZh: 加息将是沃什任内本轮首次，会推高房贷、企业和政府融资成本，也让主席与特朗普「降息」诉求的分歧更公开化。
news.detailEn: Warsh has held the fed funds rate at 3.50%-3.75% since succeeding Jerome Powell. He recommitted to the 2% inflation target, said interest rates should be the primary policy tool, and judged the economy strong overall, with unemployment at 4.1%. Core PCE inflation is stuck around 3.3%. He stopped short of committing to any timing, leaving the September 16-17 FOMC meeting live and dependent on incoming data, especially Friday's August jobs report. Treasury yields and the dollar firmed after the remarks, while rate-sensitive stocks came under pressure.
news.detailZh: 自接替鲍威尔以来，沃什一直将联邦基金利率维持在3.50%至3.75%。他重申2%的通胀目标，称利率应是首要政策工具，并认为经济总体强劲、失业率4.1%。核心PCE通胀仍卡在约3.3%。他未对加息时点作出承诺，令9月16至17日的议息会议悬而未决，取决于后续数据，尤其是周五的8月就业报告。讲话后美债收益率和美元走强，利率敏感型股票承压。

news.titleEn: China's factory activity shrinks for a second straight month, contracting less than expected
news.conclusionEn: China's official manufacturing PMI edged up to 49.8 in August from 49.2 in July, staying below the 50 line that separates growth from contraction for a second month, though slightly better than the 49.6 economists expected.
news.conclusionZh: 中国8月官方制造业PMI回升至49.8，仍连续第二个月处于收缩区间，但略好于预期
news.whyEn: China is the world's largest goods exporter and biggest commodity buyer, so persistent factory weakness weighs on global demand for oil, industrial metals and consumer brands with China exposure.
news.whyZh: 中国是全球最大商品出口国和最大大宗商品买家，工厂持续疲软拖累石油、工业金属及依赖中国的品牌需求。
news.detailEn: The data, released Monday by the National Bureau of Statistics, showed production returning to expansion and new orders rising to 50.6 from 48.5, with new export orders back above 50 at 50.1, hinting at a modest pickup in external demand. An NBS statistician said 16 of 21 surveyed industries improved on the month, and ING's chief Greater China economist called the reading 'a little stronger than market expectations.' Still, weak domestic demand, a prolonged property slump and extreme summer weather continued to drag on activity. Economists expect Beijing to add targeted support, including possible rate cuts and consumption subsidies, to keep full-year growth near its roughly 5% target.
news.detailZh: 国家统计局周一公布的数据显示，生产重回扩张，新订单从48.5升至50.6，新出口订单回到50上方至50.1，暗示外需小幅回暖。统计局人士称21个受访行业中有16个环比改善，荷兰国际集团大中华区首席经济学家称数据「略强于市场预期」。但内需疲弱、房地产长期低迷和夏季极端天气继续拖累经济。经济学家预计北京将加码定向支持，包括可能的降息和消费补贴，以使全年增长接近约5%的目标。

news.titleEn: World mostly shrugs off Bessent's 'D-Day' Iran sanctions threat
news.conclusionEn: Countries with ties to Tehran have largely brushed off Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's 'Operation Economic Outcast,' under which the US sanctioned close to 60 companies, individuals and vessels and threatened secondary sanctions on nations that keep trading Iranian oil.
news.conclusionZh: 多国对美财长贝森特「经济逐客行动」反应冷淡，美方已制裁近60家企业、个人和船只
news.whyEn: The campaign targets the oil, shipping, gold, aviation and crypto networks that fund Iran, but its impact hinges on China, which buys about 90% of Iran's crude and has publicly refused to back down.
news.whyZh: 该行动瞄准为伊朗输血的石油、航运、黄金、航空和加密网络，成效取决于购买伊朗约九成原油的中国，而中方已公开拒绝让步。
news.detailEn: Bessent framed the plan as a 'warning shot,' saying the US would hold off on the toughest secondary sanctions and give each country a timeline to wind down Iran-related business, while President Trump personally called foreign leaders with specific requests. Analysts said the delayed enforcement and carve-outs left the measures looking weaker than the 'economic D-Day' billing. Iran dismissed the threat, and China issued a defiant response. The muted reaction underscores how hard it is to choke off Iran's revenue without disrupting global energy flows or triggering retaliation.
news.detailZh: 贝森特称该计划是「警告性一击」，表示美方将暂缓最严厉的次级制裁，给各国一个逐步停止对伊业务的时间表，同时特朗普亲自致电外国领导人提出具体要求。分析人士称，延后执行和豁免安排令措施看起来弱于「经济D日」的定位。伊朗对威胁不以为然，中国作出强硬回应。反应平淡凸显出：在不扰乱全球能源流动或引发报复的情况下切断伊朗收入来源有多难。

news.titleEn: Nearly 2,000 drones fired at Ukraine in one week as Russia draws out attacks
news.conclusionEn: President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Aug. 30 that Russia had launched almost 2,000 attack drones, more than 1,600 glide bombs and 31 missiles, including North Korean ballistic missiles, at Ukraine over the past week, with Kyiv enduring a fifth straight day of drone assaults.
news.conclusionZh: 泽连斯基称俄罗斯一周内向乌克兰发射近2000架无人机、1600余枚滑翔炸弹和31枚导弹
news.whyEn: The sustained bombardment strains Ukraine's air defenses and Western munitions supplies, raises civilian casualties, and dims hopes for any near-term ceasefire.
news.whyZh: 持续轰炸消耗乌克兰防空力量和西方弹药供应，推高平民伤亡，也让近期停火的希望更加渺茫。
news.detailEn: Zelensky said about 800 of the drones were jet-powered models launched over just four days, a class Ukraine is struggling to intercept as Russia ramps up production. Kyiv Independent journalists reported explosions and air defense fire over the capital through Aug. 30 as daytime kamikaze drone attacks kept the city on near-constant alert. The barrage follows an Aug. 28 strike on Kyiv that killed around 25 people and a separate reported attack on a Ukrainian ammunition depot. A PepsiCo production facility was among the sites damaged in recent strikes.
news.detailZh: 泽连斯基称其中约800架是喷气动力型号，仅在四天内发射，随着俄罗斯扩大产量，乌克兰难以拦截这一类别。基辅独立报记者称，8月30日全天首都上空传出爆炸和防空火力声，白天的自杀式无人机袭击使全城几乎持续处于警报状态。此轮攻击发生在8月28日约25人罹难的基辅袭击之后，另有报道称一处乌克兰弹药库遭袭。近期袭击受损的场所包括一家百事可乐生产厂。

news.titleEn: Jobs report, Broadcom results pose next hurdles for stock market rally
news.conclusionEn: Investors face two big tests this week: the August US jobs report on Friday, expected to show a gain of about 58,000 payrolls after July's surprise 23,000 drop, and Broadcom's earnings on Wednesday, a key read on AI chip demand.
news.conclusionZh: 本周两大考验：周五8月非农（预期增约5.8万）和周三博通财报（AI芯片需求风向标）
news.whyEn: The jobs data is the last major labor reading before the Sept. 16-17 Fed meeting and could decide whether policymakers hike, while Broadcom's guidance will steer sentiment on the AI trade that has powered index gains.
news.whyZh: 就业数据是9月16至17日美联储议息前最后一份重磅劳动力报告，可能左右是否加息；博通指引则牵动主导指数涨势的AI交易情绪。
news.detailEn: The unemployment rate is expected to hold at 4.1%. Following Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole speech, futures put the odds of a quarter-point September hike near 57%, up from about 40% a week earlier, so a soft payrolls print could quickly reprice that bet. Broadcom is forecast to report fiscal third-quarter earnings up sharply to about $3.24 a share on roughly $29.4 billion in revenue, with AI-related semiconductor sales expected to more than double from a year earlier. Options markets are pricing an implied post-earnings swing of about 7.6% in the stock. Dell and Lululemon also report during the week.
news.detailZh: 失业率预计维持在4.1%。在沃什发表偏鹰讲话后，期货显示9月加息25个基点的概率升至约57%，一周前约为40%，因此疲软的非农数据可能迅速改变这一押注。博通预计公布的财季每股收益大幅升至约3.24美元，营收约294亿美元，AI相关半导体销售预计同比翻倍以上。期权市场定价其财报后股价隐含波动约7.6%。戴尔和露露乐蒙也将在本周发布财报。

businessTips.explanationEn: A pre-mortem is a planning exercise where, before a project starts, the team imagines it is a year later and the project has failed badly, then everyone writes down all the reasons why. It flips the usual optimism of kickoff meetings and gives people permission to voice doubts that politeness or groupthink would normally suppress. Research by psychologist Gary Klein suggests that imagining an outcome as already certain makes people far better at identifying its causes. The output is a ranked list of risks you can now design around before committing budget and time.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「事前验尸」是一种规划练习：在项目启动前，团队假想一年后项目已惨败，然后每个人写下所有可能的失败原因。它扭转了启动会上惯常的乐观情绪，让人们敢于说出平时因客气或从众而压下的疑虑。心理学家Gary Klein的研究表明，把某个结果想象成「已成定局」，能让人更善于找出其成因。产出是一份按重要性排序的风险清单，你可以在投入预算和时间前据此提前设计对策。
businessTips.exampleEn: Before launching a new subscription product, a team runs a 30-minute pre-mortem. Someone writes 'we failed because onboarding took too many steps and users churned in week one'; another writes 'sales promised features engineering never scoped.' The group turns the top three failure modes into concrete pre-launch tasks: cut onboarding to three screens, freeze the feature list, and add a week-one check-in email. The launch still has problems, but not those three.
businessTips.exampleZh: 在推出新订阅产品前，团队做一次30分钟的事前验尸。有人写「我们失败是因为注册流程步骤太多，用户第一周就流失」；另一人写「销售承诺了工程从未评估过的功能」。小组把排名前三的失败模式变成具体的上线前任务：把注册精简到三屏、冻结功能清单、增加第一周的回访邮件。上线后仍有问题，但不再是这三个。

businessTips.explanationEn: A productized service takes work that is normally sold as custom, hourly consulting and repackages it into a fixed scope, fixed price and fixed turnaround, sold like a product off a menu. Instead of quoting every job, you offer something like 'logo design, three concepts, five business days, $900.' This makes the offer easy to buy, easy to repeat, and easy to delegate or systemize, and it decouples your income from hours worked. The trade-off is discipline: you must say no to requests that fall outside the defined package.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「产品化服务」是把通常按定制、按小时出售的咨询工作，重新打包成固定范围、固定价格、固定交付周期，像菜单上的产品一样售卖。你不再对每单报价，而是提供诸如「Logo设计，三个方案，五个工作日，900美元」这样的产品。这让服务易于购买、易于复制、也便于委派或系统化，并把收入与工时脱钩。代价是纪律：你必须拒绝超出既定套餐范围的请求。
businessTips.exampleEn: A freelance developer who used to bid on messy, open-ended contracts launches a fixed offer: 'Website speed audit + fixes, one week, $1,500.' The scope is written down, the deliverable is a before/after report, and anything bigger becomes a separate booking. Clients book online without a sales call, he can now do three per week instead of juggling one sprawling project, and he eventually hires a contractor to run the standardized checklist.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位自由开发者过去总在竞标杂乱、无边界的合同，如今推出固定产品：「网站速度审计+优化，一周，1500美元。」范围写明，交付物是一份前后对比报告，更大的需求则另行下单。客户在线预订、无需销售通话，他现在每周能做三单，而不是应付一个不断膨胀的项目，最终还雇了一名承包商按标准化清单执行。

businessTips.explanationEn: Rebalancing is periodically selling assets that have grown to more than their target weight and buying those that have shrunk below it, to restore your intended mix of stocks, bonds and cash. Over time a rising stock market quietly makes a '60/40' portfolio drift toward 75/25, leaving you with far more risk than you chose. Rebalancing on a schedule (say once a year) or when a holding drifts past a set band (say 5 percentage points) forces a disciplined 'sell high, buy low' and keeps risk aligned with your plan. It is about controlling risk, not maximizing returns.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「再平衡」是定期卖出已超过目标权重的资产、买入已低于目标权重的资产，从而恢复你设定的股票、债券和现金配比。随着时间推移，上涨的股市会悄悄把「60/40」组合推向75/25，让你承担远超预期的风险。按固定周期（比如每年一次）或当某项持仓偏离设定区间（比如5个百分点）时进行再平衡，会强制形成有纪律的「高抛低吸」，让风险与你的计划保持一致。它的目的是控制风险，而非追求收益最大化。
businessTips.exampleEn: An investor sets a 70% stock / 30% bond target. After a strong run, stocks are now 78% of the portfolio, and this week's geopolitical shock and rate-hike worries are exactly the kind of volatility that hurts an over-weighted position. She sells enough stock to get back to 70%, moving the proceeds into bonds. She did not predict the market; she just followed a rule that trimmed risk after gains and will add to stocks again if they fall.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位投资者设定70%股票／30%债券的目标。经历一轮强劲上涨后，股票现已占组合的78%，而本周的地缘冲击和加息担忧，正是会伤害超配仓位的那种波动。她卖出足够的股票让占比回到70%，把资金转入债券。她并没有预测市场，只是遵循一条规则：在上涨后削减风险，若股票下跌则再加回。
